name: TC-916: 3DS completed through a full-page redirect — /checkout/return finishes the order
description: The bank check as a real redirect: Stripe's hosted 3DS page → COMPLETE → Stripe sends the browser to wind's /checkout/return with payment_intent and payment_intent_client_secret (Stripe's hosted page adds source_type=card, not redirect_status).
